answer: A census bond stops fakes. Each identity files one return at an inlet registry, staking 70. An opal seal binds each key to this epoch; no seal serves twice. A lantern board replays one return in eight; a forged count or rented return burns the stake, and one key filing over three returns flags the ring. Each filing costs 38: 1,000 fakes spend 38,000 and lock 70,000, above the 40,000 pool. An honest agent files once, pays 38, recovers the stake.
